summary: Solowin Holdings filed a Form 6-K furnishing a notice of extraordinary general meeting and proxy statement for a meeting to be held October 13, 2026. Shareholders are asked to approve a 1-for-200 share consolidation, effective on or about October 26, 2026 as coordinated with Nasdaq, and a subsequent increase in authorized share capital from US$100,000 to US$5,000,000,000. Fractional entitlements will be rounded up to the nearest whole share. No price, premium, acquisition, or special-situation transaction terms are stated; this is a routine capital-structure/EGM notice, not a special situation.
